nodes.label: frontend.core
nodes.desc: Entry namespace for the mobile, browser and Electron apps; mounts the root React component through the rfx provider.

nodes.label: handler.editor/save-block!
nodes.desc: Editor event handlers for typing, insert, delete and move; every keystroke path funnels through outliner ops.

nodes.label: outliner.op/transact!
nodes.desc: Builds semantic outliner ops (:save-block, :insert-blocks, :move-blocks, :delete-blocks) that are applied atomically.

nodes.label: frontend.handler/start!
nodes.desc: System component that boots IndexedDB, plugin setup, the persist-db runtime and graph restore.

nodes.label: frontend.state
nodes.desc: Main application state and subscriptions; routes every UI-thread call to the db worker via <invoke-db-worker.

nodes.label: db.transact/apply-outliner-ops
nodes.desc: Serializes outliner mutations per repo and forwards op batches to the db worker thread.

nodes.label: worker.db-worker
nodes.desc: Dedicated browser worker that owns the graph database; exposed to the main thread over Comlink.

nodes.label: db.subs
nodes.desc: Immutable renderer snapshots loaded from the worker-owned graph database, with deltas flushed to React.

nodes.label: DataScript conn
nodes.desc: get-storage-conn restores an in-memory DataScript connection whose datoms are backed by SQLite storage.

nodes.label: db.sqlite file
nodes.desc: get-db-full-path maps a graph to its db.sqlite file; a kvs table stores DataScript storage pages.

nodes.label: db.query-dsl/query
nodes.desc: DSL queries like {{query}} are dispatched to the db worker as thread-api requests.

nodes.label: db.query-custom
nodes.desc: Advanced queries are validated Datalog vectors (:find first) executed through the worker.
